    Class
    Description
    LifecycleListener
    Observer callback for model deployment lifecycle events, useful for wiring up logging, metrics, or alerting around deployments without changing LifecycleManager itself.
    LifecycleManager
    Orchestrates the deployment lifecycle of a model version:
    ManagedModel
    A model identity (a stable modelId) whose underlying InferenceEngine can be hot-swapped, canaried, and shadowed over time without callers ever holding a stale reference.
    ShadowListener
    Observer callback fired after a shadow inference call completes (or fails), letting you wire up comparison logging/metrics between a primary version and a shadow version without changing LifecycleManager or ManagedModel.

    Tracks a single deployment attempt of a model version as it moves through the lifecycle: validate → warm → active → retired (or failed at any prior stage).
    ModelVersion.Status
    The stage a ModelVersion is currently in.
